require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'
require 'bcrypt'
require 'rack/protection'

module SecurityHeaders
  FRAME_DENY = 'DENY'
  FRAME_SAMEORIGIN = 'SAMEORIGIN'
  
  # Allowed policy types for frame protection
  POLICY_TYPES = [FRAME_DENY, FRAME_SAMEORIGIN, 'ALLOW-FROM'].freeze
  
  # Validates that a frame policy string is well-formed
  def self.valid_policy?(policy)
    return false unless policy.is_a?(String)
    return false if policy.empty?
    return false if policy.length > 256
    
    # Check if policy type is in our allowed list
    policy_type = policy.split(' ', 2).first
    return false unless POLICY_TYPES.include?(policy_type)
    
    # For ALLOW-FROM, validate the origin
    if policy_type == 'ALLOW-FROM'
      origin = policy.split(' ', 2).last
      return false unless origin =~ /\Ahttps:\/\/[\w\-\.]+\z/
    end
    
    true
  end
  
  # Apply the validated policy to response headers
  def self.apply(headers, policy)
    return apply_default(headers) unless policy
    
    case policy
    when FRAME_DENY
      headers['X-Frame-Options'] = 'DENY'
      headers['Content-Security-Policy'] = "frame-ancestors 'none'"
    when FRAME_SAMEORIGIN
      headers['X-Frame-Options'] = 'SAMEORIGIN'
      headers['Content-Security-Policy'] = "frame-ancestors 'self'"
    else
      # Must be ALLOW-FROM since valid_policy? already checked
      if policy.start_with?('ALLOW-FROM')
        origin = policy.split(' ', 2).last
        headers['X-Frame-Options'] = policy
        headers['Content-Security-Policy'] = "frame-ancestors #{origin}"
      else
        apply_default(headers)
      end
    end
  end
  
  def self.apply_default(headers)
    headers['X-Frame-Options'] = 'DENY'
    headers['Content-Security-Policy'] = "frame-ancestors 'none'"
  end
end

class ConfigStore
  def initialize
    @mutex = Mutex.new
    @policies = {}
    @audit_log = []
  end
  
  def update_policy(path_pattern, policy, source_id)
    @mutex.synchronize do
      @policies[path_pattern] = policy
      @audit_log << { time: Time.now.utc, path: path_pattern, policy: policy, source: source_id }
    end
  end
  
  def policy_for(request_path)
    @mutex.synchronize do
      # Find most specific matching policy
      match = @policies.keys.select { |pattern| path_matches?(request_path, pattern) }
                              .max_by(&:length)
      match ? @policies[match] : nil
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def path_matches?(path, pattern)
    if pattern.end_with?('*')
      path.start_with?(pattern[0..-2])
    else
      path == pattern
    end
  end
end

$config_store = ConfigStore.new

class App < Sinatra::Base
  use Rack::Protection
  use Rack::Protection::RemoteToken
  use Rack::Protection::HttpOrigin
  
  set :sessions, true
  set :session_secret, ENV['SESSION_SECRET'] || SecureRandom.hex(32)
  
  before do
    policy = $config_store.policy_for(request.path_info)
    SecurityHeaders.apply(headers, policy)
  end
  
  # Admin endpoint to update frame policies
  post '/admin/frame-policy' do
    halt 403 unless session[:role] == 'admin'
    
    data = JSON.parse(request.body.read, symbolize_names: true)
    path_pattern = data[:path_pattern].to_s
    policy = data[:policy].to_s
    
    # Validate the policy before storing
    unless SecurityHeaders.valid_policy?(policy)
      halt 400, { error: 'Invalid policy' }.to_json
    end
    
    $config_store.update_policy(path_pattern, policy, session[:user_id])
    { status: 'updated' }.to_json
  end
  
  get '/dashboard' do
    halt 401 unless session[:user_id]
    erb :dashboard
  end
  
  post '/api/transfer' do
    halt 401 unless session[:user_id]
    content_type :json
    
    data = JSON.parse(request.body.read, symbolize_names: true)
    amount = data[:amount].to_f
    recipient = data[:recipient].to_s
    
    halt 400, { error: 'Invalid amount' }.to_json unless amount > 0 && amount <= 10000
    halt 400, { error: 'Invalid recipient' }.to_json unless recipient =~ /\A[a-zA-Z0-9_]+\z/
    
    { status: 'success', amount: amount, recipient: recipient }.to_json
  end
  
  post '/login' do
    content_type :json
    data = JSON.parse(request.body.read, symbolize_names: true)
    username = data[:username].to_s
    password = data[:password].to_s
    
    user = authenticate(username, password)
    if user
      session[:user_id] = user[:id]
      session[:role] = user[:role]
      { status: 'ok' }.to_json
    else
      sleep(0.1 + rand * 0.1)  # Timing-safe rejection
      halt 401, { error: 'Invalid credentials' }.to_json
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def authenticate(username, password)
    # Placeholder - in production uses bcrypt
    nil
  end
end
